name: Madrid Ashtanga Shala
reason: No usable photo: its own site (madridashtangashala.com; robots.txt allows us) is built on Framer, so every image sits on framerusercontent.com, whose robots.txt request is refused (403, 10 Nov 2026); per the 6 Nov lesson a refused robots.txt blocks the host, and the ingest would refuse the images. Otherwise a fair candidate: Alexia Pita's SYC-authorised shala (Level 2), now in Torrelodones (Colonia) after nine years in central Madrid, with Mysore classes, a prices page, retreats and workshops, and a published email (info@alexiapitayoga.com). Only the home page was read.
